claims.claim: Codex REMEDIATION instructions now bind result.head_sha to actual final Git HEAD and explicitly bind zero-mutation EVIDENCE_ONLY output to the unchanged admitted run.base_sha rather than remediation.reviewed_sha.

REPAIR admission reconstructs and validates the canonical origin REMEDIATION from immutable failed-RUN lineage, fails closed on lineage conflicts, and carries only its affected_verification tuple forward.

Runtime repair completion executes TASK verification followed by origin affected verification with stable de-duplication, while repairs without a REMEDIATION origin retain their existing verification tuple unchanged.

Integrated zero-mutation EVIDENCE_ONLY completion-gate failures can be FINALIZE_CANDIDATE repaired without advancing HEAD, while preserving the integrated result base and Runtime-owned evidence binding.
Existing integrated CODE_FIX dual-base behavior remains intact: result attribution uses the validated integrated candidate while mutation authority remains anchored to failed_head_sha.

Focused regressions cover prompt head binding, deterministic verification de-duplication, forged affected-verification rejection, and production-shaped integrated EVIDENCE_ONLY repair behavior; changes are confined to authorized files.
